decision: Retain 10 ms. At 30 Hz this is 30 percent of one control tick and equals the formula cap. Runtime waits already split sleeps into chunks no longer than stop_poll_s and re-check the stop condition between chunks.
scope_limit: This calibrates the polling interval, not end-to-end physical stopping latency. CAL-102 risk acceptance and hardware stop-latency measurement remain unresolved.
